text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. Unlike simple keyword matching, NLP focuses on the meaning behind words. With NLP, machines can translate text between languages and even perform sentiment analysis to detect whether a review is positive, negative, or neutral. This technology also powers chatbots, which can answer customer questions and provide support at any time of day. By combining grammar rules with machine learning, NLP allows computers to read, interpret, and respond to language in a surprisingly human way, making communication with technology more natural and efficient.
